inlineSql: Select 1 AS SrNo,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_NAME,B.AC_ADD1,B.AC_MOBILE,B.AC_CITY,C.IT_TYPE, SUM(Case When C.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN A.ITM_NWT ELSE 0 END) As RecGold, SUM(Case When C.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN A.ADJ_NWT ELSE 0 END) As AdjGold, SUM(Case When C.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN A.ITM_NWT-A.ADJ_NWT ELSE 0 END) As BalGold, SUM(Case When C.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN A.ITM_NWT ELSE 0 END) As RecSilver, SUM(Case When C.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN A.ADJ_NWT ELSE 0 END) As AdjSilver, SUM(Case When C.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN A.ITM_NWT-A.ADJ_NWT ELSE 0 END) As BalSilver FROM (APR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = C.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.BOOK_NAME = 'CON REC' and A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY A.AC_CODE,B.AC_NAME,B.AC_ADD1,B.AC_MOBILE,B.AC_CITY,C.IT_TYPE ORDER BY B.AC_NAME
Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
SELECT CO_BOOK,VCH_NO,AC_NAME FROM SL_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '
SELECT CO_BOOK,VCH_NO,AC_NAME FROM PR_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '

Select Case When SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) < 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As DrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) > 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As CrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrGold, Case When SUM(Case When A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrGold, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrSilver, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrSilver FROM (AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ?

Select B.BOOK_NAME,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.LEDR_KEY,A.LD_CODE As AC_CODE,C.AC_NAME,C.AC_ADD1,C.AC_MOBILE,B.MAIN_BOOK,C.AC_AREA, Case When SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) < 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As DrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) > 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As CrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrGold, Case When SUM(Case When A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrGold, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrSilver, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrSilver,B.MAIN_BOOK FROM (AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.LD_CODE = C.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY B.BOOK_NAME,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.LEDR_KEY,A.LD_CODE,C.AC_NAME,C.AC_ADD1,C.AC_MOBILE,B.MAIN_BOOK,C.AC_AREA ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,B.BOOK_NAME
SELECT Sum(CR_AMT - DR_AMT) as BalAmt FROM AC_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' and VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' HAVING SUM(CR_AMT-DR_AMT) <> 0
Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT AC_NAME As AcNameL,AC_CODE As AcCodeL, AC_GR AS GroupL,AC_ADD1 As AddressL,AC_PHONE As PhoneL,AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY AC_NAME

SELECT Sum(CR_AMT - DR_AMT) as BalAmt FROM AC_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' and VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? HAVING SUM(CR_AMT-DR_AMT) <> 0
